name: vendra-florist

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.components.json && tsc -p tsconfig.api.json
scripts.check: node tools/build.mjs --check && prettier --check tools components app build communications deployment domain e2e i18n next server session shared styles tests types *.mjs *.json && npm run lint:css
scripts.format: prettier --write tools components app build communications deployment domain e2e i18n next server session shared styles tests types *.mjs *.json
scripts.dev:next: npm run build && node next/prepare-assets.mjs && node next/prepare-fixtures.mjs && next dev
scripts.build:next: npm run build && node next/prepare-assets.mjs && VF_NEXT_EXPORT=1 next build && node next/finish-export.mjs
scripts.build:live: npm run build && node next/prepare-assets.mjs && next build

description: Vendra Next.js storefront and its design system.
